property_summary: For any caller and any ETH amount, when Owner calls Command(addr,data) forwarding ETH, the reference contract's call to the callee executes as a payable call (succeeds if callee accepts the funds) while the mutant performs a staticcall (no value) which causes calls that require/observe nonzero msg.value to either fail or behave differently; thus the reference never forces a revert solely due to value-not-forwarded for a callee that accepts value, but the mutant can cause failure — we assert that calling Command on a helper that requires ETH succeeds for all admissible amounts, which the mutant will break for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace call invocation to use staticcall (no value) so the forwarded value is not sent and call is executed as a view/static call; also require success.
